hooks.command: fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *pnpm-lock.yaml|*.env|*.env.*) echo 'BLOCKED: do not edit lock files or .env files directly' >&2; exit 2;; esac

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit'; then branch=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then if { git diff --cached --name-only; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git\s+commit.*(\s--all(\s|$)|\s-[a-zA-Z]*a)'; then git diff --name-only; fi; } | grep -qE '^(apps/|server/|supabase/|contracts/|scripts/|\.github/|package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|pnpm-workspace\.yaml|turbo\.json|go\.work)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: main 上禁止直接提交 CI 把关路径（apps/ server/ supabase/ contracts/ scripts/ .github/ 及根构建清单），请切 feature 分支走 PR；docs/ .scratch/ Makefile 与根级文档可直接提交' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; fi
fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.css|*.yaml) npx prettier --write "$fp" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$fp" in *.go) $(go env GOPATH)/bin/goimports -w "$fp" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
